title: Dart
description: Build cross-platform apps with Flutter — Dart types, OOP and async.

chapters.title: Dart & the VM
objectives: Explain the core ideas behind flutter and dart run.
Write and run working Dart code that uses flutter, dart run, JIT/AOT.
Recognise and avoid the common pitfalls associated with pub.
notes: Note — Dart & the VM: flutter / dart run / JIT/AOT / pub are the heart of this chapter. Read the sample, then type it yourself.
Good practice: keep every example short and runnable; add a comment that records the expected output exactly.
International standard: every topic points to its section in the appendix and lists revisable key terms at the end.

exercises.question: What is the purpose of flutter in Dart?
exercises.answer: flutter lets you pub — see chapter section 1.2.

exercises.question: Modify the example to keep three decimal places instead of two.
exercises.answer: Format the printed value with the language's precision formatter (e.g. printf/round), then re-run and compare.

exercises.question: When would you avoid pub?
exercises.answer: Avoid it when the task is better served by a simpler, linear approach — momentum matters more than cleverness.

tests.instructions: One assessment per chapter grouping plus a final exam. Every question maps to the section shown in brackets so you can revise precisely.

questions.q: Which concept makes flutter behave that way? (Dart ch.1)
The worked sample prints "Hello, Dart". Which statement caused it? (ch.1)
Which concept makes var behave that way? (Dart ch.2)
The worked sample prints "true". Which statement caused it? (ch.2)
Which concept makes => behave that way? (Dart ch.3)
The worked sample prints "Each map entry mapped by the function". Which statement caused it? (ch.3)
Which concept makes class behave that way? (Dart ch.4)
The worked sample prints "Checkout gains Discounts behaviour". Which statement caused it? (ch.4)
Which concept makes List behave that way? (Dart ch.5)
The worked sample prints "Adding to taxes throws". Which statement caused it? (ch.5)
Which concept makes async behave that way? (Dart ch.6)
The worked sample prints "Resolves or throws after 5s". Which statement caused it? (ch.6)
Which concept makes Widget behave that way? (Dart ch.7)
The worked sample prints "Elapsed widget renders the price". Which statement caused it? (ch.7)

assessment.q: Write Dart code that reads a value, transforms it and prints the result. (final)
What does the score of 14.3 marks per chapter tell you about this exam's structure? (final)
